biggest_catch: The offer expires September 25, 2026 (2 days from verification date), and the payout takes a long time — direct deposit of $500+/month for 3 consecutive months, with the bonus posting by the 5th of the month after a 90-day waiting period.
catches: Use promo code MK-CHECKING when opening the account (mention it or enter it in the online application).
Open a new CCU Florida checking account (Free Checking Plus); subject to approval.
Establish a direct deposit of $500 or more within 90 days of account opening and continue a direct deposit of $500 or more for three consecutive months.
Acceptable direct deposits: paycheck, pension, or government benefits (e.g., Social Security). Transfers from an account and person-to-person transfers do not qualify.
Not available to current CCU Florida checking account holders, joint owners on a checking account, or anyone who closed a checking account within the past 24 months.
Incentive payout will post by the 5th of the month, following the 90 days after meeting the requirements.
Membership available in Brevard, Indian River, Orange, Osceola, Polk & Volusia Counties (FL); a share savings account with a $5 one-time membership fee is required at account opening.
Free Checking Plus has zero monthly fees or balance requirements.
Offer is available between July 1 - September 25, 2026.
